metadata.description: {\rtf1\ansi Plugin Shelf for REAPER\par A visual plugin browser: your plugins and FX chains as thumbnails on a shelf, sorted into your own categories.\par \par - Tiles show the plugin's own window (screen capture), so you find plugins by how they look\par - FX chains as tiles, with mini thumbnails of every plugin inside\par - Search by bits of words in any order ("comp air" finds AIR Compressor)\par - Quick Switch: hold Left Alt and type a category number, 0 + Enter = Home\par - Right-click a tile > Presets: insert the plugin with a preset loaded\par - Override script: REAPER's FX button opens Plugin Shelf instead of the stock window\par \par Runs as a free DEMO with no time limit. A license key unlocks the full version.\par Requires ReaImGui (ReaPack). REAPER 7. For REAPER 6 use the Lua 5.3 package from the shop.\par Full package with manuals, icon pack and toolbar icon: see the Shop link. }
